import numpy as np
def _aim(target, observer):
    offset = np.asarray(target, dtype=float) - np.asarray(observer, dtype=float)
    rho = float(np.linalg.norm(offset))
    return offset / rho, rho
def _probe(v, scale=1.0):
    v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
    if v.shape != (6,):
        return -1.0e3
    return float(scale * (v[3:] @ np.array([1.0, -2.0, 3.0])) + 0.1 * (v[:3] @ np.array([0.5, 0.25, -1.0])))
obs_near = np.array([0.1, -0.2, 0.05])
obs_far = np.array([-0.5326, 0.7595, 0.3293])
u_near, rho_near = _aim([0.6, 0.8, 0.3], obs_near)
u_far, rho_far = _aim([-5.02, -25.1, 1.61], obs_far)
u_flat, rho_flat = _aim([1.3, -0.4, 0.0], [0.2, 0.1, 0.0])
assert np.allclose(_probe(construct_emission_state(u_near.copy(), obs_near.copy(), rho_near, 0.2, 1.1, 0.9, 1)), target)
